content: Laravel 11 Eloquent dispatches creating and created when a new model is first saved; updating and updated apply to existing models, while saving and saved apply to both create and update. The official observer pattern groups lifecycle methods and registers with Model::observe from a service provider. A created observer therefore gives creation-only coverage for every Eloquent save path that uses the package Campaign model, and the observer can implement ShouldHandleEventsAfterCommit when it must wait for an enclosing transaction to commit. Source: official Laravel 11 Eloquent events and observers documentation.
